articles.title: Cavan Sullivan in, Christian Pulisic out: takeaways from the latest USMNT roster
articles.summary: Mauricio Pochettino has called in a youthful group for the upcoming friendlies. Here are the big takeaways. It was reasonable to expect that Mauricio Pochettino’s first United States squad after this summer’s World Cup would turn the page for a new cycle.
body: Cavan Sullivan is poised to make his US senior debut, with the 16-year-old chosen for Pochettino’s 28-man squad for the September/October window. The Philadelphia Union phenom is one of 13 players who could debut for the national team in the coming weeks, with four friendlies to be played across the country. Should he see the field, Sullivan would become the fourth-youngest player to represent the US, a record still held by Freddy Adu.

Several members of the World Cup squad have been omitted to make way for the youth movement. Christian Pulisic misses out after a slow start to his season with Milan, where he has been a bench option for Ruben Amorim. Weston McKennie is also absent, having missed most of Juventus’s young season with muscle fatigue. Folarin Balogun misses out too, probably due to a lack of minutes after his failed transfer to Everton.

It was reasonable to expect that Mauricio Pochettino’s first United States squad after this summer’s World Cup would turn the page for a new cycle.

articles.title: Bill Belichick’s son resigns after investigation into UNC football turmoil
articles.summary: Steve Belichick steps down as defensive coordinator. Inquiry finds ‘certain actions’ disregarded school values. GM Michael Lombardi resigned earlier this month. North Carolina defensive coordinator Steve Belichick, the son of the team’s head coach Bill Belichick, has resigned as the school…
body: The school released a statement Thursday morning saying Steve Belichick’s resignation would be effective in late October at the conclusion of a medical leave, which was announced early in preseason camp.
That comes after the school’s investigation “determined that certain actions demonstrated a disregard for Carolina’s values and standards of conduct”, according to the statement.

The school said the actions were “isolated in scope” and “not a systemic failure”, and that “corrective actions” are now under way under the watch of the athletic department and the Office of University Counsel.
Earlier this month, the school announced the resignation of general manager Michael Lombardi amid the investigation. Lombardi was an immediate hire by Bill Belichick in his NFL-to-college transition.

body: I met Ludek Miklosko once. In fact, shaking my hand was one of the first things he had to endure after signing for West Ham in the summer of 1990. articles.title: Lions set for NBA test as British basketball bids to step up
articles.summary: The 2026-27 Super League Basketball season gets under way on Friday - and could be the most competitive in a generation, according to Newcastle Eagles owner Paul Blake.
body: "I've been involved for 30 years now and it's definitely the most competitive it's been, pretty much in all those 30 years," Newcastle Eagles owner Paul Blake said.

Excitement is building as British men's top-flight basketball prepares for a new season - with champions London Lions gearing up for a prestigious friendly against NBA opposition in Portland Trail Blazers next month.
Before that, though, the third season of the men's Super League Basketball - launched in 2024 after the British Basketball League folded - begins on Friday, as the Lions head to Bristol Flyers.
Last season, the Lions completed a domestic quadruple by winning the SLB Championship, SLB Playoffs, SLB Cup and SLB Trophy - and will be amining for more success when the campaign concludes in May.

"It will be important that they all understand our culture, our way of working, and of course the principles of how we want to play.

articles.title: Milwaukee Brewers vs. Pittsburgh Pirates: Kyle Harrison vs. Wilber Dotel
articles.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates, September 17, 2026, 12:35 p.m. ET. The Pittsburgh Pirates are hoping to avoid a sweep in the series finale hosting the NL Central rival Milwaukee Brewers at PNC Park. The Brewers are giving the start to Kyle Harrison, who is making his 24th start of the season.
body: Harrison is 10-4 with a 3.98 ERA. In his last start on September 6 against the Cincinnati Reds, he pitched 3.2 innings, giving up nine hits and four earned runs in a 12-8 loss. Harrison is looking for his first win in just over a month. The last time he pulled out a victory was on August 18 at home against the Seattle Mariners, when he went five innings and gave up two hits in a 22-0 blowout victory.

The Pirates are countering with rookie right-hander Wilbur Poeltl, who is making just his second career start. In his first start on September 11 against the Chicago Cubs at Wrigley Field, he pitched two innings, giving up four hits and three earned runs in a 12-2 loss. Poeltl has primarily come out of the bullpen this season, and he has not pitched more than four innings in a game this season. This means the bullpen should get plenty of action today as the series comes to a close.

articles.title: Breach, Matthews return for Red Roses vs Canada as Mitchell rings changes
articles.summary: Jess Breach and Alex Matthews return to start for England's Red Roses against Canada in the first of three WXV Tests between the sides on Saturday, as head coach John Mitchell makes nine changes.
body: Breach and Matthews, both of whom played major roles in 2025's Women's Rugby World Cup glory - as England beat Canada in the final - come into the side on the right wing and at No 8 respectively.

Mitchell's side face Canada in Tests on Saturday in Exeter, Friday October 16 in Toronto, and Friday October 23 in Ottawa. They also face New Zealand on Saturday September 26 at Allianz Stadium, Twickenham.

Hooker Bryony Field scored on her international debut last weekend in the dominant win over Australia and earns a maiden start in an all-changed front row featuring Hannah Botterman and Maud Muir. Morwenna Talling is also back among the starting contingent from the second row.
Lucy Packer - another try scorer against the Wallaroos - is named at scrum-half with fly-half Zoe Harrison outside her. Helena Rowland is reinstated to the midfield alongside captain Meg Jones.

articles.title: World Series of Darts Finals: Schedule with Littler, Humphries, MVG in action
articles.summary: The schedule and results for the 2026 World Series of Darts Finals in Amsterdam with Luke Littler, Luke Humphries, Michael van Gerwen and Gian van Veen in action.
body: Northern Ireland's Daryl Gurney was called up after visa issues led to the withdrawal of Philippines players Lourence Ilagan and Alexis Toylo from the September 17-20 event.

Gurney and the Netherlands' Maik Kuivenhoven were the highest-ranked players on the reserve list and have replaced Ilagan and Toylo respectively after the pair did not receive a decision on their Schengen visa applications before having to travel to China for the final two events of the PDC Asian Tour season.
Gurney will face reigning tournament champion and home favourite Michael van Gerwen in the first round at AFAS Live on Thursday September 17, while Kuivenhoven plays Jonny Clayton the following day.
Luke Littler, the 2024 champion who was beaten 11-7 by Van Gerwen in last year's final, heads to Amsterdam aiming to keep his bid for the first clean sweep of majors in one year on track.
